summary: Frontend E2E test of the new Contabilidad (accounting) module as admin test@preview.com. I tested all 10 requested flows and all of them passed: sidebar/dashboard entry, week/month/year modes with prev/next, validation toasts, creating an expense with a bank account and receipt, the Cuentas ledger sync, edit to 60 and delete with balance restore, a cash expense with no receipt, a custom 'Comida' category, PDF download, and the bar and donut charts. Test data was cleaned up afterwards.

minor.issue: Keys made from labels are not de-duplicated. Two categories with the same label (or labels that normalise to the same key) get the same key, which merges their totals. Removing a category that existing expenses use makes later edits of those expenses fail with 400 'Categoría no válida' unless the user picks a new category.
Ledger created_at is fixed to {date}T12:00:00+00:00 (UTC), so in Ecuador (UTC-5) the Cuentas row shows 07:00. This is cosmetic only.

issues: Store tax shows as '$-11,65'. Use '−$11,65' to match the expense rows.
The 'capitalize' CSS turns 'octubre de 2026' into 'Octubre De 2026'. Capitalise only the first letter in JS.
The Contabilidad card sits before Cuentas, while in the sidebar it comes after Cuentas. Small ordering inconsistency.

action_items: Optional: de-duplicate category keys in PUT /accounting/categories
Optional: fix the negative money format and the period label capitalisation
critical_code_review_comments: periodRange week mode calls getWeekKey(now.toISOString()). This works, but passing the Date directly is clearer.
When a category is removed, past expenses still render using category_label as a fallback, which is OK. Editing them, though, forces the user to choose a new category.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ui nomina (45.50, edited to 60, Banco Pichincha Wilber), TEST_cash (10, no account) and category 'Comida'. All were deleted afterwards: categories restored to the 8 defaults (now stored explicitly on the tenant) and the Wilber balance is back to $2,072.55.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login inputs are duplicated in the DOM (mobile and desktop), so use the ':visible' selector. Preview clock is Oct 2026; the current week is 22–28 Oct (Thu–Wed). Deleted expense ledger rows stay in Cuentas with an 'Eliminada' badge and are excluded from the balance.
